# Cloud-agent connector fixtures (lanes CA-B1, CA-B2)

Recorded CLI JSON for the node pull connectors in `internal/cloudagents`.
All identifiers, logins and repository names are invented (`acme-dev`,
`octo-dev`); no real account data.

| File | Command | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `codex-cloud/list-page1.json`, `list-page2.json` | `codex cloud list --json --limit 20 [--cursor C]` | Built from the documented schema (reference chapter 03, CX01: a `tasks` array of `id, url, title, status, updated_at, environment_id, environment_label, summary, is_review, attempt_total` plus an optional `cursor`). Flags grounded against `codex-cli 0.166.0` (`codex cloud list --help`, 2026-10-31). Not a live capture: the grounding host had no signed-in Codex account (`Not signed in. Please run 'codex login'`, exit 1). `summary` appears both as an object and as a string to pin the tolerant decode; the status values (`pending`, `ready`, `error`) are the Codex Cloud task states as best known and are mapped through the connector's status table, where an unlisted value becomes `unknown`. |
| `copilot-agent/list.json` | `gh agent-task list --json id,name,state,repository,user,createdAt,updatedAt,completedAt,pullRequestNumber,pullRequestUrl,pullRequestState -L 100` | Shape taken from gh 2.89.0 source, `pkg/cmd/agent-task/capi/sessions.go` `Session.ExportData`: `repository` is the PR repository's `nameWithOwner` or null, `user` is the login or null, times are RFC 3339 or null; the list is sorted `last_updated_at,desc` and keeps the latest session per PR. States from `pkg/cmd/agent-task/shared/display.go`. Not a live capture (the host's gh token was invalid). |
| `copilot-agent/view.json` | `gh agent-task view <id> --json <same fields>` | Same `ExportData` shape, one object. |
| `copilot-agent/user.json` | `gh api user` | The GitHub REST `GET /user` shape; only `id` and `login` are read. |
| `cursor-cloud/stream-live.sse`, `stream-resume.sse` | `GET /v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}/stream` (SSE), then the same with `Last-Event-ID: 1792264210000-13` (lane CA-B2) | **Shape live-verified 2026-11-01, values synthetic.** Event ids are `<epoch ms>-<seq>`. A `tool_call` event's data is `{callId, name, status, args?, result?}`: each call sends two or three `running` events (the first without `args`) and one `completed` event with `result` `{success:{...}}` or `{error:{errorMessage, stdout, stderr}}`. Call ids contain `|`, as live. Tool names are the live ones: `read_file`, `file_search`, `edit_file`, `run_terminal_cmd`, `communicate_update`, `create_agent` (its result `{success:{agentId:"bc-<uuid>", message}}`), `send_message`. The first stream ends without `done` (a live run read for one window), with `edit_file` still running and `run_terminal_cmd` still argless; the second resumes, completes both (the command fails) and ends with `result` and `done`. Every path, command, message, diff, output and id is invented; result bodies say `SYNTHETIC` so a test can prove none is stored. |

| `cursor-cloud/agents.json` | `GET https://api.cursor.com/v1/agents?limit=100` | **Shape live-verified 2026-11-01, values synthetic.** The member names and nesting are verbatim from a live Cursor Pro account (four agents): `items[]` of `id` (`bc-<uuid>`), `name`, `status` (`IDLE` was the only agent status seen), `env` (`{"type":"cloud","id":...}` or `{"type":"cloud","name":"<owner>/tmp-<16 hex>"}`), `repos[]` (`{"url"}` or, for a Cursor-hosted scratch repository, `{"url":"https://origin.cursor.com/git/<owner>/tmp-<hex>","startingRef"}`), `workOnCurrentBranch`, `openAsCursorGithubApp`, `skipReviewerRequest`, `url`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `latestRunId`; no `nextCursor` when everything fits one page. The items are ordered by `updatedAt` newest first, as live (NOT by `createdAt`). Every id, name, repository, owner and time is invented. |
| `cursor-cloud/runs-a01.json` .. `runs-a04.json` | `GET /v1/agents/{id}/runs?limit=100` for the four agents | **Shape live-verified 2026-11-01, values synthetic.** `items[]` of `id` (`run-<uuid>`), `agentId`, `status` (`FINISHED` and `CANCELLED` seen live), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `durationMs`, `git.branches[]` of `repoUrl` (with its `https://` scheme) and `branch`; newest first by `createdAt`, `items[0].id` equal to the agent's `latestRunId`. Agent 1 has four runs, agent 2 three (on a Cursor scratch repository), agents 3 and 4 one each: nine runs, as on the live account. |
| `cursor-cloud/usage-a01.json` .. `usage-a04.json` | `GET /v1/agents/{id}/usage` | **Shape live-verified 2026-11-01, values synthetic.** `totalUsage` and `runs[].usage` of `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `totalTokens` (the total equals the four parts exactly, as in all four live agents, so input is already net of cache), `cost` of `rawCostCents` (fractional cents) and `chargedCents` on the agent and on each run, and `runs[].usageUuid`. Agent 1's raw total is 14.24463 cents (the sum of its runs); agent 2 has one run charged 2.5 cents, everything else is charged 0 (included usage). Agent 3 (`usage-a03.json`) has an agent total ABOVE the sum of its runs (0.98 vs 0.61 cents, 10400 vs 6500 tokens), as three of the four live agents had (by 35 to 50 percent; the values here are illustrative): the agent carries usage no run reports. |
| `devin/sessions.json`, `devin/messages.json` | `GET https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions?first=200`, then `.../sessions/{id}/messages?first=200` | **Shape live-verified 2026-11-01, values synthetic.** The envelope is `{items, end_cursor, has_next_page, total}` (`total` null, `end_cursor` null on the last page). Session items carry every live member (`session_id` as 32 hex with no prefix, `status` plus `status_detail`, `user_id` as `user-<32 hex>`, `org_id` as `org-<32 hex>`, Unix-second `created_at` / `updated_at`, `acus_consumed`, `parent_session_id`, `child_session_ids`, `origin`, `devin_mode`, `security_profile` and the rest). Session 1 is `running` + `waiting_for_user` (awaiting instructions, as live); session 2 is its child (`parent_session_id`), `running` + `working`. Messages carry `event_id` (`event-<32 hex>`), `source`, `message`, `created_at`, `username`, `user_id`, `origin`. Every id, title, name and text is invented; message texts say `SYNTHETIC`. |

The other API connector responses are the lane CA-A4 driver fixtures under
`testdata/vendorapi/{cursor,cognition,openhands}/` (their sidecars record
provenance), read directly by the tests.

The `cline-cloud` connector (lane CA-V6) reads the driver fixtures under
`testdata/vendorapi/cline/` (`cline.cloud.sessions`,
`cline.cloud.session_status`, `cline.cloud.session_history`). They are
synthesized from the vendor's own client, not from a published API: each
sidecar records npm `@cline/core` 0.2.0 (or `@cline/shared` 0.2.0) with file
hashes and `github.com/cline/cline` commit
`a6507a62a147db4a35e27f4294589742ccac5060`, and the coverage level "Observed in
vendor client, undocumented". No value comes from a real account.
